articles.title: State Farm and Allstate File Plans to Resume California Home Insurance Sales
articles.description: Key Takeaways State Farm is proposing a limited return centered on homes meeting verified IBHS wildfire-mitigation standards, while Allstate’s return remains tied to regulatory approval. California homeowners can prepare now for the IBHS Wildfire Prepared Home process, which requires physical mitigation work, a $125 application fee and independent verification. Neither insurer is writing new California State Farm and Allstate seek to resume California home insurance sales as wildfire mitigation standards reshape eligibility and underwriting.
